Designed for those who love a traditional look, this stand turns your artificial Christmas tree into a charming centrepiece with playful stacked presents. The sturdy platform is perfect for showing off your favourite gifts and creating a magical atmosphere for family and friends. Enjoy a unique and practical way to elevate your holiday décor.
